deviations.description: Suspected (not verified; weights unavailable): the network may apply rule B whenever any mandible lies inside the PTV and cov exceeds mand_lim, ignoring the 5%-of-PTV-volume allowance. Large PTVs with modest mandible overlap (forced <= 0.1 cc) would then be escalated even though rule B does not apply and no other rule fires.
deviations.condition: (mand_in_ptv > 0.4) and (mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol < -0.2) and (cov > mand_lim + 0.3) and (cov < cap - 0.3) and (cord_lim > cord_floor + 0.3) and (missing == 0)
